name: 84081 · West Jordan, UT
findings: ZIP 84081 (West Jordan) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84081 (West Jordan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84081 (West Jordan) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 26% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
